target: a 200-word product blog post with stock AI-writing patterns
prompt: draft.md reads like a chatbot wrote it. Rewrite it so it sounds like a person on our engineering team wrote it, same facts. Save as draft-v2.md.
rubric: Removes inflated significance, promotional wording, vague attribution ('Experts agree'), negative parallelism ('not just … it's'), forced threes, em dashes, chatbot sign-off and emoji
Keeps every fact and number and the hedge about unmeasured customer benefit
Reads like a specific engineer wrote it, not a template
